description:
UNDER OFFER!!
APP Kirrane Auctioneering are delighted to bring to the market this charming three bedroom semi-detached property, ideally positioned at the end of the small and established Cherryvale residential estate in Ballyhaunis, Co. Mayo.

Built in 2002, this well positioned home offers a generous total floor area of approximately 108.34 sq.m., with the added benefit of a peaceful end of estate location and no passing traffic.

Within easy walking distance of Ballyhaunis town centre, Ballyhaunis Train station and all local amenities, the property combines convenience with a quiet residential setting. 

The property offers off street parking to the front and a private rear garden, together with oil fired central heating and uPVC windows and doors.  Having previously been rented, the property is now vacant and ready for immediate occupation, making it an excellent opportunity for an owner occupier, investor, retiree or holiday home.

The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall with staircase to the first floor, leading to a large sitting room with front aspect window.  To the rear is an open plan kitchen dining area, together with a separate utility room and convenient guest WC.

Upstairs, a spacious landing provides access to the shelved hotpress and attic space.  there are two generous double bedrooms, with the master bedroom benefiting from an ensuite,  A single bedroom and a family sized bathroom completing the accommodation.

The location is ideal for those seeking the convenience of town living while enjoying easy access to the beautiful surrounding countryside.  Ireland West Airport Knock is just a short drive away, while the area is also renowned for its selection of fishing lakes, scenic walks and golf courses.  Galway City, Sligo, Athlone and Westport are all within an hour's drive, making this an attractive base for commuting, leisure or holiday use.  Ireland West Airport and Knock Shine only twenty minutes away.  

This is a wonderful opportunity to acquire a spacious and well located home in a quiet residential setting, close to all that Ballyhaunis has to offer.  For further information or to arrange a viewing please make contact with the Sole Selling Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering where everything we touch turns to SOLD.
